what: Runs of the VND checkout (mock gateway) on the ui-gaps preview, Fuji, 22 Nov 2026 (+07): a first purchase (ticket 149), a resale through the line (ticket 146) and a refund with its bank payout record (ticket 3)
note: The bank code and salt of this demo payment are published here on purpose, so the check can be repeated. A real buyer's code and salt stay on the buyer's phone.

resaleThroughTheLine.seller: 0xfDb413E342dF83411B96aE9B34a3FDC426A76366 (project test wallet Guest B, sent with cast)
resaleThroughTheLine.buyer: 0xE889078B34C9AAEC5f7FB3bB4e766aB1a379EB7E (a new device key made by the preview app in a fresh browser)

steps.what: The seller's earlier listing of ticket 146 is taken down, so the GA line can open (the contract refuses a line while a listing is open)
The buyer taps 'Xếp hàng · đặt cọc 715.000đ' and confirms the mock transfer VG42MBAJ54; after the signed webhook the relayer moves 27.5 settlement units from its float into the buyer's account
The relayer sends the buyer's account the fee for one transaction (0.01 test AVAX)
The buyer's own account joins the line with the deposit (joinWaitlistWithPermit): first in line
The seller lists ticket 146 at the cap; in the same transaction the contract sells it to the first in line and pays the seller from the deposit

payment.onChainRecord: none: a deposit has no ticket yet, so it is in the payment ledger only

refundWithPayoutRecord.event: Soundcheck Session: ended with 0 of 4 paid tickets scanned, a no-show, refunds open
refundWithPayoutRecord.holder: 0x9638F49A3cB7c002779724b427905F6Ab1D54BFA (project test wallet Guest A, sent with cast)

steps.what: The holder orders the refund on chain (claimRefund): the ticket is burned and 10 settlement units, the price paid, leave the vault
The preview relayer checks that transaction (POST /pay/payout), issues the bank payout record HT34X5CJXC for 260.000đ and records its hash for ticket 3 in PaymentReceipts, kind 2 (refund payout)

payout.gateway: mock (no real money moved; the chain cannot make VND move, it records the order and the proof)

refundWithPayoutRecord.note: The holder's side was sent with cast from a project test wallet, because no device of the preview held a refundable ticket; in the app the same two steps run from the ticket screen's refund button.
